title: SPI Master — Wrong Clock Polarity (CPOL=1 mode)
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SPI] MISO sampled on wrong edge; CPOL=1 requires idle-high clock, got idle-low
expected_root_cause: The SPI clock idles low (sclk=0 on reset) but CPOL=1 mode requires the clock to idle high; data is therefore sampled on the wrong edge and all received bytes are corrupt.
testbench:
// SPI monitor checks sclk idle state between CS assertions
assert property (@(posedge clk) !cs_n |-> sclk == CPOL);
failure_log: UVM_ERROR: [SPI] MISO sampled on wrong edge; CPOL=1 requires idle-high clock, got idle-low
success_log: sclk idles high between CS assertions. MISO sampled on correct falling edge.
